#Environment

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)

library(patchwork)

library(semhelpinghands)
library(flextable)

sx_wmci_p <- "~/Downloads/Psychopathology_WMCI/preprocessed_data_deidentified_20260615.csv" #add path here
```

#Read in data

```{r}

sx_wmci <- read_csv(sx_wmci_p)

```

#Descriptive statistics

```{r}

#time (weeks) at pre WMCI
sx_wmci %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(dem_gest_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(dem_gest_weeks, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#time (months) at post WMCI 
sx_wmci %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(dem_childage_months_session_6mo, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(dem_childage_months_session_6mo, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#mom age
sx_wmci %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(dem_mom_age_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(dem_mom_age_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(dem_mom_age_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(dem_mom_age_preg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#income-to-needs
sx_wmci %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(dem_incomeneeds_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(dem_incomeneeds_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(dem_incomeneeds_preg, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(dem_incomeneeds_preg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#primiparous
sx_wmci <- sx_wmci %>%
  mutate(
    primiparous = case_when(
      dem_childreninhome_preg == 0 ~ "Yes",
      dem_childreninhome_preg >= 1 ~ "No",
      is.na(dem_childreninhome_preg) ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(dem_childreninhome_preg) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#marital status
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(dem_maritalstat_txt_preg) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#education
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(dem_momedu_txt_preg) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#race
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(dem_momrace_txt) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#ethinicity
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(dem_momlatinx_txt_preg) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#child sex
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(child_sex) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

```

#Representations descriptives

```{r}

#prenatal
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::count(wmci_cat_pre) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#postnatal
sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(wmci_cat_6mo)) %>%
  dplyr::count(wmci_cat_6mo) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#change
change_df <- sx_wmci %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(wmci_cat_pre), !is.na(wmci_cat_6mo))

change_df %>%
  dplyr::count(wmci_cat_pre, wmci_cat_6mo) %>%
  group_by(wmci_cat_pre) %>%
  mutate(percent_of_pre = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

change_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(wmci_cat_pre %in% c(2, 3)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_preUn = n(),
    n_to_balanced        = sum(wmci_cat_6mo == 1),
    percent_to_balanced  = 100 * n_to_balanced / n_total_preUn
  )

change_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(wmci_cat_pre == 1) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_preBal  = n(),
    n_to_Unb       = sum(wmci_cat_6mo %in% c(2, 3)),
    percent_to_Unb = 100 * n_to_Unb / n_total_preBal
  )

```

```{r}
  lm(

    data = sx_wmci

#dimensions

#correlations pre

vars <- c("factor1_pre", "factor2_pre", "factor3_pre", "cesd_sum_pre", "bai_sum_pre", "asrs_tot_pre", "dem_mom_age_preg", "dem_gest_weeks", "dem_momedu_preg", "dem_childreninhome_preg")
          
corr_res <- psych::corr.test(
  sx_wmci[, vars],
  use = "pairwise",
  method = "pearson"
)

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < .001, "***",
         ifelse(p < .01, "**",
                ifelse(p < .05, "*", "")))
}

stars <- matrix(
  p_to_stars(corr_res$p),
  nrow = nrow(corr_res$p),
  dimnames = dimnames(corr_res$p)
)

corr_with_stars <- matrix(
  paste0(round(corr_res$r, 2), stars),
  nrow = nrow(corr_res$r),
  dimnames = dimnames(corr_res$r)
)
corr_with_stars
```

#Distribution of symptoms

```{r}

#color palette
sxwmci_pal <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9")  

#depression
cesd_long <- sx_wmci %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(cesd_sum_pre, cesd_sum_post), 
               names_to = "timepoint", 
               values_to = "cesd_score")

cesd <- ggplot(cesd_long, aes(x = cesd_score, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, color = "black", linetype = "longdash", size = 1) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = sxwmci_pal, labels = c("Prenatal", "Postnatal")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Depressive symptoms",
    y = "Density", 
    fill = "Timepoint"
  )

#anxiety
bai_long <- sx_wmci %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(bai_sum_pre, bai_sum_post), 
               names_to = "timepoint", 
               values_to = "bai_sum")

bai <- ggplot(bai_long, aes(x = bai_sum, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 22, color = "black", linetype = "longdash", size = 1) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = sxwmci_pal, labels = c("Prenatal", "Postnatal")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Anxiety symptoms",
    y = "Density", 
    fill = "Timepoint"
  )

#ADHD
asrs_long <- sx_wmci %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(asrs_tot_pre, asrs_tot_post), 
               names_to = "timepoint", 
               values_to = "asrs_tot")

asrs <- ggplot(asrs_long, aes(x = asrs_tot, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 38, color = "black", linetype = "longdash", size = 1) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = sxwmci_pal, labels = c("Prenatal", "Postnatal")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "ADHD symptoms",
    y = "Density", 
    fill = "Timepoint"
  )

#combine
bai <- bai + theme(legend.position = "none")
asrs <- asrs + theme(legend.position = "none")

symptom_density <-
  (cesd + bai + asrs) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

#ggsave("symptom_density.png", plot = symptom_density, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

#CFA for pre and postnatal transdiagnostic psychopathology measure

```{r}

#prenatal
mod_pre <- '
  prenatalsx =~ cesd_sum_pre + bai_sum_pre + asrs_tot_pre
  postnatalsx =~ cesd_sum_post + bai_sum_post + asrs_tot_post

#correlated residuals
  cesd_sum_post ~~ cesd_sum_pre
  bai_sum_post ~~ bai_sum_pre
  asrs_tot_post ~~ asrs_tot_pre
  
#associations between latents
  prenatalsx ~~ postnatalsx
  
'
fit_pre <- cfa(mod_pre, data = sx_wmci, estimator = "MLR", missing = "FIML")

summary(fit_pre, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit_pre, ci = TRUE)

```

#Aim 1: Latent model categorical

```{r}

#dummy code representations
sx_wmci$diseng_pre <- ifelse(sx_wmci$wmci_cat_pre == "2", 1, 0) 
sx_wmci$distort_pre <- ifelse(sx_wmci$wmci_cat_pre == "3", 1, 0) 

sx_wmci$diseng_6mo <- ifelse(sx_wmci$wmci_cat_6mo == "2", 1, 0) 
sx_wmci$distort_6mo <- ifelse(sx_wmci$wmci_cat_6mo == "3", 1, 0) 

#numerical parity
sx_wmci <- sx_wmci %>%
  mutate(parity = case_when(
    primiparous == "No"  ~ 0,
    primiparous == "Yes" ~ 1
  ))

mod_cat <- '
  #latent variables
  prenatalsx =~ cesd_sum_pre + bai_sum_pre + asrs_tot_pre
  postnatalsx =~ cesd_sum_post + bai_sum_post + asrs_tot_post

  #regressions prenatal
  diseng_pre ~ a1*prenatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + parity
  distort_pre ~ a2*prenatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg

  #regressions at 6 months
  diseng_6mo ~ b1*diseng_pre + c1*prenatalsx + e1*postnatalsx 
  distort_6mo ~ b2*distort_pre + c2*prenatalsx + e2*postnatalsx 
  
  #label this path
  postnatalsx ~ d*prenatalsx

  #covariates, symptoms associations
  cesd_sum_pre ~ dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_pre ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_post ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + bai_sum_pre
  cesd_sum_post ~ cesd_sum_pre
  bai_sum_post ~ bai_sum_pre
  asrs_tot_post ~ asrs_tot_pre

  #within-time residual covariances
  diseng_pre ~~ distort_pre
  diseng_6mo ~~ distort_6mo

  #formation indirect effects (prenatal -> pre WM -> 6mo WM)
  ind1 := a1 * b1
  ind2 := a2 * b2

  #continuity indirect effects (prenatal -> postnatal -> 6mo WM)
  ind_post_f1 := d * e1
  ind_post_f2 := d * e2
'
fit_cat <- sem(mod_cat, data = sx_wmci, estimator = "MLR", missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit_cat, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit_cat, ci = TRUE)

#run on bootstraps for indirect effects
fit_cat_bt <- sem(mod_cat, data = sx_wmci, missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)
summary(fit_cat_bt, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution_boot_ci(fit_cat_bt, boot_ci_type = "bca.simple")

```

#Aim 1: Latent model continuous

```{r}

mod_cont <- '
  #latent variables
  prenatalsx =~ cesd_sum_pre + bai_sum_pre + asrs_tot_pre
  postnatalsx =~ cesd_sum_post + bai_sum_post + asrs_tot_post

  #regressions prenatal
  factor1_pre ~ a1*prenatalsx + dem_momedu_preg + parity
  factor2_pre ~ a2*prenatalsx + dem_momedu_preg + parity
  factor3_pre ~ a3*prenatalsx

  #regressions at 6 months
  factor1_6mo ~ b1*factor1_pre + c1*prenatalsx + e1*postnatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg
  factor2_6mo ~ b2*factor2_pre + c2*prenatalsx + e2*postnatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  factor3_6mo ~ b3*factor3_pre + c3*prenatalsx + e3*postnatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  
  #label this path
  postnatalsx ~ d*prenatalsx

  #covariates, symptoms associations
  cesd_sum_pre ~ dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_pre ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_post ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + bai_sum_pre
  cesd_sum_post ~ cesd_sum_pre
  bai_sum_post ~ bai_sum_pre
  asrs_tot_post ~ asrs_tot_pre

  #within-time residual covariances
  factor1_pre ~~ factor2_pre
  factor1_pre ~~ factor3_pre
  factor2_pre ~~ factor3_pre
  factor1_6mo ~~ factor2_6mo
  factor1_6mo ~~ factor3_6mo
  factor2_6mo ~~ factor3_6mo

  #formation indirect effects (prenatal -> pre WM -> 6mo WM)
  ind1 := a1 * b1
  ind2 := a2 * b2
  ind3 := a3 * b3

  #continuity indirect effects (prenatal -> postnatal -> 6mo WM)
  ind_post_f1 := d * e1
  ind_post_f2 := d * e2
  ind_post_f3 := d * e3
'
fit_cont <- sem(mod_cont, data = sx_wmci, estimator = "MLR", missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit_cont, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit_cont, ci = TRUE)

#run on bootstraps for indirect effects
fit_cont_bt <- sem(mod_cont, data = sx_wmci, missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)
summary(fit_cont_bt, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution_boot_ci(fit_cont_bt, boot_ci_type = "bca.simple")

```

#Aim 2: symptom-specific models 

```{r}


#depression, categorical
mod_dep_cat <- '
  diseng_6mo ~ cesd_sum_pre + cesd_sum_post + diseng_pre 
  distort_6mo ~ cesd_sum_pre + cesd_sum_post + distort_pre 
  
  diseng_pre ~ cesd_sum_pre + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + parity
  distort_pre ~ cesd_sum_pre + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  
  cesd_sum_pre ~ dem_momedu_preg
  cesd_sum_post ~ cesd_sum_pre

  #within-time residual covariances
  diseng_pre ~~ distort_pre
  diseng_6mo ~~ distort_6mo
  
'
fit_dep_cat <- sem(mod_dep_cat, data = sx_wmci, estimator = "MLR", missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit_dep_cat, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit_dep_cat, ci = TRUE)
```

```{r}

#labels (used by every table)
var_labels <- c(

  cesd_sum_post = "Postnatal CES-D", bai_sum_post = "Postnatal BAI", asrs_tot_post = "Postnatal ASRS",
  diseng_pre = "Prenatal disengaged", distort_pre = "Prenatal distorted",
  diseng_6mo = "Postnatal disengaged", distort_6mo = "Postnatal distorted",
  factor1_pre = "Prenatal positive engagement",
  factor2_pre = "Prenatal relational coherence and support",
  factor3_pre = "Prenatal caregiving frustration",
  factor1_6mo = "Postnatal positive engagement",
  factor2_6mo = "Postnatal relational coherence and support",
  factor3_6mo = "Postnatal caregiving frustration",
  dem_mom_age_preg = "Maternal age", dem_momedu_preg = "Maternal education",
  parity = "Parity"
)

#dummy-coded outcomes get "(versus balanced)"
dummy_vars <- c("diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "diseng_6mo", "distort_6mo")

#row order in the tables
outcome_order <- c("cesd_sum_pre", "bai_sum_pre", "asrs_tot_pre",
                   "cesd_sum_post", "bai_sum_post", "asrs_tot_post",
                   "diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "factor1_pre", "factor2_pre", "factor3_pre",
                   "postnatalsx",
                   "diseng_6mo", "distort_6mo", "factor1_6mo", "factor2_6mo", "factor3_6mo")

predictor_order <- c("diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "factor1_pre", "factor2_pre", "factor3_pre",
                     "cesd_sum_pre", "bai_sum_pre", "asrs_tot_pre", "prenatalsx",
                     "cesd_sum_post", "bai_sum_post", "asrs_tot_post", "postnatalsx",
                     "dem_mom_age_preg", "dem_momedu_preg", "parity")

#indirect effect labels
pp <- "Prenatal psychopathology \u2192 "

ind_labels_cat <- c(
  ind1 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal disengaged \u2192 Postnatal disengaged"),
  ind2 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal distorted \u2192 Postnatal distorted"),
  ind_post_f1 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal disengaged"),
  ind_post_f2 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal distorted"))

ind_labels_cont <- c(
  ind1 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal positive engagement \u2192 Postnatal positive engagement"),
  ind2 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal relational coherence and support \u2192 Postnatal relational coherence and support"),
  ind3 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal caregiving frustration \u2192 Postnatal caregiving frustration"),
  ind_post_f1 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal positive engagement"),
  ind_post_f2 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal relational coherence and support"),
  ind_post_f3 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal caregiving frustration"))

#number formatting
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", x, fixed = TRUE)

fmt_num <- function(x, d = 2) {
  out <- sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x)
  small <- !is.na(x) & x != 0 & abs(x) < 0.005
  out[small] <- sprintf("%.3f", x[small])
  tiny <- small & abs(as.numeric(out)) == 0
  out[tiny] <- sprintf("%.4f", x[tiny])
  minus(out)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

#shared table style (Arial 11, single spaced, APA-like borders)
style_ft <- function(ft, ci_cols, n_cols) {
  ft %>%
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
    line_spacing(space = 1, part = "all") %>%
    padding(padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1, part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 2:n_cols, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "header") %>%
    hline(i = 1, j = ci_cols, border = fp_border(width = 0.5), part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "body")
}

#regression table: works on any fitted lavaan object
make_reg_ft <- function(fit) {
  
  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit, ci = FALSE) %>%
    filter(op == "~") %>%
    select(lhs, rhs, B = est, SE = se, z, p = pvalue)
  
  ss <- standardizedSolution(fit, level = .95) %>%
    filter(op == "~") %>%
    select(lhs, rhs, beta = est.std, lo = ci.lower, hi = ci.upper)
  
  reg <- inner_join(pe, ss, by = c("lhs", "rhs")) %>%
    distinct(lhs, rhs, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  #stop with a clear message if a variable is missing from the dictionaries
  unknown <- setdiff(c(reg$lhs, reg$rhs), names(var_labels))
  if (length(unknown)) stop("Add to var_labels: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(setdiff(reg$lhs, outcome_order))) stop("Add to outcome_order: ", paste(setdiff(reg$lhs, outcome_order), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(setdiff(reg$rhs, predictor_order))) stop("Add to predictor_order: ", paste(setdiff(reg$rhs, predictor_order), collapse = ", "))
  
  #one header row per outcome, followed by its predictors
  rows <- map_dfr(outcome_order[outcome_order %in% reg$lhs], function(o) {
    d <- reg %>% filter(lhs == o) %>% arrange(match(rhs, predictor_order))
    hdr <- paste0(var_labels[[o]], if (o %in% dummy_vars) " (versus balanced)" else "")
    bind_rows(
      tibble(Label = hdr, B = "", SE = "", z = "", p = "", beta = "", lo = "", hi = "", is_header = TRUE),
      tibble(Label = unname(var_labels[d$rhs]),
             B = fmt_num(d$B), SE = fmt_num(d$SE), z = fmt_num(d$z), p = fmt_p(d$p),
             beta = fmt_num(d$beta), lo = fmt_num(d$lo), hi = fmt_num(d$hi),
             is_header = FALSE))
  })
  
  ft <- flextable(select(rows, -is_header)) %>%
    set_header_labels(Label = "Outcome / Predictor", B = "B", SE = "SE", z = "z",
                      p = "p", beta = "\u03B2", lo = "Lower", hi = "Upper") %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", "95% CI around \u03B2"), colwidths = c(6, 2))
  
  #italic statistical symbols
  for (v in c("B", "SE", "z", "p")) {
    ft <- compose(ft, i = 2, j = v, part = "header", value = as_paragraph(as_i(v)))
  }
  
  ft %>%
    bold(i = which(rows$is_header), part = "body") %>%
    padding(i = which(!rows$is_header), j = 1, padding.left = 14, part = "body") %>%
    style_ft(ci_cols = 7:8, n_cols = 8) %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 2.3) %>%
    width(j = 2:8, width = 0.58)
}

#indirect effects table: bootstrap (BCa) CIs around the standardized estimate
make_ind_ft <- function(fit_bt, ind_labels) {
  
  sb <- standardizedSolution_boot_ci(fit_bt, boot_ci_type = "bca.simple") %>%
    filter(op == ":=") %>%
    select(lhs, beta = est.std, lo = ci.lower, hi = ci.upper) %>%
    filter(lhs %in% names(ind_labels)) %>%
    arrange(match(lhs, names(ind_labels))) %>%
    transmute(Path = unname(ind_labels[lhs]),
              beta = fmt_num(beta), lo = fmt_num(lo), hi = fmt_num(hi))
  
  flextable(sb) %>%
    set_header_labels(Path = "Indirect association", beta = "\u03B2", lo = "Lower", hi = "Upper") %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", "95% CI around \u03B2"), colwidths = c(2, 2)) %>%
    style_ft(ci_cols = 3:4, n_cols = 4) %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 4.6) %>%
    width(j = 2:4, width = 0.6)
}

#one entry per table (edit table numbers and titles here)
cat_note  <- "Disengaged and distorted representations are dummy coded (reference = balanced)."
cont_note <- "Representation dimensions are sums of WMCI scales."

specs <- list(
  list(no = "S4", fit = fit_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Categorical Model: Transdiagnostic Psychopathology and Mental Representations",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cat_bt, labels = ind_labels_cat)),
  list(no = "S5", fit = fit_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Continuous Model: Transdiagnostic Psychopathology and Mental Representations",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cont_bt, labels = ind_labels_cont)),
  list(no = "S6", fit = fit_dep_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Depressive Symptoms and Mental Representations (Categorical)"),
  list(no = "S7", fit = fit_dep_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Depressive Symptoms and Mental Representations (Continuous)"),
  list(no = "S8", fit = fit_anx_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Anxiety Symptoms and Mental Representations (Categorical)"),
  list(no = "S9", fit = fit_anx_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Anxiety Symptoms and Mental Representations (Continuous)"),
  list(no = "S10", fit = fit_adhd_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "ADHD Symptoms and Mental Representations (Categorical)"),
  list(no = "S11", fit = fit_adhd_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "ADHD Symptoms and Mental Representations (Continuous)")
)

#text style for titles and notes (Arial 11, single spaced)
arial11 <- function(...) fp_text(font.family = "Arial", font.size = 11, ...)
single  <- fp_par(line_spacing = 1)

#loop over tables and export to Word
doc <- read_docx()

for (s in specs) {
  
  note <- paste0(" B = unstandardized coefficient; SE = robust standard error; ",
                 "\u03B2 = standardized coefficient; CI = confidence interval around \u03B2. ",
                 s$note, " N = ", lavInspect(s$fit, "nobs"), ".")
  
  doc <- doc %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(paste("Table", s$no), arial11(bold = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(s$title, arial11(italic = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
    body_add_flextable(make_reg_ft(s$fit)) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext("Note.", arial11(italic = TRUE)), ftext(note, arial11()), fp_p = single))
  
  #indirect effects (main models only)
  if (!is.null(s$ind)) {
    doc <- doc %>%
      body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
      body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(paste("Table", s$no, "(continued): Indirect Associations"), arial11(bold = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
      body_add_flextable(make_ind_ft(s$ind$bt, s$ind$labels)) %>%
      body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext("Note.", arial11(italic = TRUE)),
                         ftext(" Confidence intervals are bias-corrected and accelerated bootstrap intervals (5,000 resamples) around the standardized indirect effect.", arial11()),
                         fp_p = single))
  }
  
  doc <- body_add_break(doc)
}

print(doc, target = "supplementary_tables.docx")
```

#sensitivity analysis - all covariates on categorical model

```{r}

#numerical (dummy) child sex
sx_wmci <- sx_wmci %>%
  mutate(boy = case_when(
    child_sex == "Female"  ~ 0,
    child_sex == "Male" ~ 1
  ))

mod_cat_sens <- '
  #latent variables
  prenatalsx =~ cesd_sum_pre + bai_sum_pre + asrs_tot_pre
  postnatalsx =~ cesd_sum_post + bai_sum_post + asrs_tot_post

  #regressions prenatal
  diseng_pre ~ a1*prenatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_gest_weeks + dem_momedu_preg + parity + dem_momlatinx_preg
  distort_pre ~ a2*prenatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_gest_weeks + dem_momedu_preg + parity + dem_momlatinx_preg

  #regressions at 6 months
  diseng_6mo ~ b1*diseng_pre + c1*prenatalsx + e1*postnatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + parity + dem_momlatinx_preg + boy + dem_childage_months_session_6mo
  distort_6mo ~ b2*distort_pre + c2*prenatalsx + e2*postnatalsx + dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + parity + dem_momlatinx_preg + boy + dem_childage_months_session_6mo

  #label this path
  postnatalsx ~ d*prenatalsx

  #covariates, symptoms associations
  cesd_sum_pre ~ dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_pre ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg
  bai_sum_post ~ dem_mom_age_preg + dem_momedu_preg + bai_sum_pre
  cesd_sum_post ~ cesd_sum_pre
  bai_sum_post ~ bai_sum_pre
  asrs_tot_post ~ asrs_tot_pre

  #within-time residual covariances
  diseng_pre ~~ distort_pre
  diseng_6mo ~~ distort_6mo

  #formation indirect effects (prenatal -> pre WM -> 6mo WM)
  ind1 := a1 * b1
  ind2 := a2 * b2

  #continuity indirect effects (prenatal -> postnatal -> 6mo WM)
  ind_post_f1 := d * e1
  ind_post_f2 := d * e2
'
fit_cat_sens <- sem(mod_cat_sens, data = sx_wmci, estimator = "MLR", missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit_cat_sens, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution(fit_cat_sens, ci = TRUE)

#run on bootstraps for indirect effects
fit_cat_sens_bt <- sem(mod_cat_sens, data = sx_wmci, missing = "FIML", fixed.x = FALSE, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)
summary(fit_cat_sens_bt, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
standardizedSolution_boot_ci(fit_cat_sens_bt, boot_ci_type = "bca.simple")

```

```{r}
dummy_vars <- c("diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "diseng_6mo", "distort_6mo")

#row order in the tables
outcome_order <- c("cesd_sum_pre", "bai_sum_pre", "asrs_tot_pre",
                   "cesd_sum_post", "bai_sum_post", "asrs_tot_post",
                   "diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "factor1_pre", "factor2_pre", "factor3_pre",
                   "postnatalsx",
                   "diseng_6mo", "distort_6mo", "factor1_6mo", "factor2_6mo", "factor3_6mo")

predictor_order <- c("diseng_pre", "distort_pre", "factor1_pre", "factor2_pre", "factor3_pre",
                     "cesd_sum_pre", "bai_sum_pre", "asrs_tot_pre", "prenatalsx",
                     "cesd_sum_post", "bai_sum_post", "asrs_tot_post", "postnatalsx",
                     "dem_mom_age_preg", "dem_gest_weeks", "dem_momedu_preg",
                     "parity", "dem_momlatinx_preg", "boy",
                     "dem_childage_months_session_6mo")

#indirect effect labels
pp <- "Prenatal psychopathology \u2192 "

ind_labels_cat <- c(
  ind1 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal disengaged \u2192 Postnatal disengaged"),
  ind2 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal distorted \u2192 Postnatal distorted"),
  ind_post_f1 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal disengaged"),
  ind_post_f2 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal distorted"))

ind_labels_cont <- c(
  ind1 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal positive engagement \u2192 Postnatal positive engagement"),
  ind2 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal relational coherence and support \u2192 Postnatal relational coherence and support"),
  ind3 = paste0(pp, "Prenatal caregiving frustration \u2192 Postnatal caregiving frustration"),
  ind_post_f1 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal positive engagement"),
  ind_post_f2 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal relational coherence and support"),
  ind_post_f3 = paste0(pp, "Postnatal psychopathology \u2192 Postnatal caregiving frustration"))

#number formatting
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", x, fixed = TRUE)

fmt_num <- function(x, d = 2) {
  out <- sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x)
  small <- !is.na(x) & x != 0 & abs(x) < 0.005
  out[small] <- sprintf("%.3f", x[small])
  tiny <- small & abs(as.numeric(out)) == 0
  out[tiny] <- sprintf("%.4f", x[tiny])
  minus(out)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

#shared table style (Arial 11, single spaced, APA-like borders)
style_ft <- function(ft, ci_cols, n_cols) {
  ft %>%
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
    line_spacing(space = 1, part = "all") %>%
    padding(padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1, part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 2:n_cols, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "header") %>%
    hline(i = 1, j = ci_cols, border = fp_border(width = 0.5), part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "body")
}

#regression table: works on any fitted lavaan object
make_reg_ft <- function(fit) {

  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit, ci = FALSE) %>%
    filter(op == "~") %>%
    select(lhs, rhs, B = est, SE = se, z, p = pvalue)

  ss <- standardizedSolution(fit, level = .95) %>%
    filter(op == "~") %>%
    select(lhs, rhs, beta = est.std, lo = ci.lower, hi = ci.upper)

  reg <- inner_join(pe, ss, by = c("lhs", "rhs")) %>%
    distinct(lhs, rhs, .keep_all = TRUE)

  unknown <- setdiff(c(reg$lhs, reg$rhs), names(var_labels))
  if (length(unknown)) stop("Add to var_labels: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(setdiff(reg$lhs, outcome_order))) stop("Add to outcome_order: ", paste(setdiff(reg$lhs, outcome_order), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(setdiff(reg$rhs, predictor_order))) stop("Add to predictor_order: ", paste(setdiff(reg$rhs, predictor_order), collapse = ", "))

  rows <- map_dfr(outcome_order[outcome_order %in% reg$lhs], function(o) {
    d <- reg %>% filter(lhs == o) %>% arrange(match(rhs, predictor_order))
    hdr <- paste0(var_labels[[o]], if (o %in% dummy_vars) " (versus balanced)" else "")
    bind_rows(
      tibble(Label = hdr, B = "", SE = "", z = "", p = "", beta = "", lo = "", hi = "", is_header = TRUE),
      tibble(Label = unname(var_labels[d$rhs]),
             B = fmt_num(d$B), SE = fmt_num(d$SE), z = fmt_num(d$z), p = fmt_p(d$p),
             beta = fmt_num(d$beta), lo = fmt_num(d$lo), hi = fmt_num(d$hi),
             is_header = FALSE))
  })

  ft <- flextable(select(rows, -is_header)) %>%
    set_header_labels(Label = "Outcome / Predictor", B = "B", SE = "SE", z = "z",
                      p = "p", beta = "\u03B2", lo = "Lower", hi = "Upper") %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", "95% CI around \u03B2"), colwidths = c(6, 2))

  for (v in c("B", "SE", "z", "p")) {
    ft <- compose(ft, i = 2, j = v, part = "header", value = as_paragraph(as_i(v)))
  }

  ft %>%
    bold(i = which(rows$is_header), part = "body") %>%
    padding(i = which(!rows$is_header), j = 1, padding.left = 14, part = "body") %>%
    style_ft(ci_cols = 7:8, n_cols = 8) %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 2.3) %>%
    width(j = 2:8, width = 0.58)
}

#indirect effects table: bootstrap (BCa) CIs around the standardized estimate
make_ind_ft <- function(fit_bt, ind_labels) {

  sb <- standardizedSolution_boot_ci(fit_bt, boot_ci_type = "bca.simple") %>%
    filter(op == ":=") %>%
    select(lhs, beta = est.std, lo = ci.lower, hi = ci.upper) %>%
    filter(lhs %in% names(ind_labels)) %>%
    arrange(match(lhs, names(ind_labels))) %>%
    transmute(Path = unname(ind_labels[lhs]),
              beta = fmt_num(beta), lo = fmt_num(lo), hi = fmt_num(hi))

  flextable(sb) %>%
    set_header_labels(Path = "Indirect association", beta = "\u03B2", lo = "Lower", hi = "Upper") %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", "95% CI around \u03B2"), colwidths = c(2, 2)) %>%
    style_ft(ci_cols = 3:4, n_cols = 4) %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 4.6) %>%
    width(j = 2:4, width = 0.6)
}

#one entry per table
cat_note <- "Disengaged and distorted representations are dummy coded (reference = balanced)."
cont_note <- "Representation dimensions are sums of WMCI scales."

specs <- list(
  list(no = "S4", fit = fit_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Categorical Model: Transdiagnostic Psychopathology and Mental Representations",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cat_bt, labels = ind_labels_cat)),

  list(no = "S5", fit = fit_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Continuous Model: Transdiagnostic Psychopathology and Mental Representations",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cont_bt, labels = ind_labels_cont)),

  list(no = "S6", fit = fit_cat_sens, note = cat_note,
       title = "Sensitivity Analysis: Categorical Model with Expanded Covariate Adjustment",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cat_sens_bt, labels = ind_labels_cat)),

  list(no = "S7", fit = fit_cont_sens, note = cont_note,
       title = "Sensitivity Analysis: Continuous Model with Expanded Covariate Adjustment",
       ind = list(bt = fit_cont_sens_bt, labels = ind_labels_cont)),

  list(no = "S8", fit = fit_dep_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Depressive Symptoms and Mental Representations (Categorical)"),

  list(no = "S9", fit = fit_dep_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Depressive Symptoms and Mental Representations (Continuous)"),

  list(no = "S10", fit = fit_anx_cat, note = cat_note,
       title = "Anxiety Symptoms and Mental Representations (Categorical)"),

  list(no = "S11", fit = fit_anx_cont, note = cont_note,
       title = "Anxiety Symptoms and Mental Representations (Continuous)"),

  list(no = "S12", fit = fit_adhd_cat, note = cat_note,

#text style for titles and notes (Arial 11, single spaced)
arial11 <- function(...) fp_text(font.family = "Arial", font.size = 11, ...)
single <- fp_par(line_spacing = 1)

#loop over tables and export to Word
doc <- read_docx()

for (s in specs) {

  note <- paste0(" B = unstandardized coefficient; SE = standard error; ",
                 "\u03B2 = standardized coefficient; CI = confidence interval around \u03B2. ",
                 s$note, " N = ", lavInspect(s$fit, "nobs"), ".")

  doc <- doc %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(paste("Table", s$no), arial11(bold = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(s$title, arial11(italic = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
    body_add_flextable(make_reg_ft(s$fit)) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext("Note.", arial11(italic = TRUE)), ftext(note, arial11()), fp_p = single))

  if (!is.null(s$ind)) {
    doc <- doc %>%
      body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
      body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(paste("Table", s$no, "(continued): Indirect Associations"), arial11(bold = TRUE)), fp_p = single)) %>%
      body_add_flextable(make_ind_ft(s$ind$bt, s$ind$labels)) %>%
      body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext("Note.", arial11(italic = TRUE)),
                         ftext(" Confidence intervals are bias-corrected and accelerated bootstrap intervals (5,000 resamples) around the standardized indirect effect.", arial11()),
                         fp_p = single))
  }

  doc <- body_add_break(doc)
}

print(doc, target = "supplementary_tables_sens.docx")
```
